answer: Trust edges decay on a timer, so a vouch is worth nothing unless both ends keep working and renew it; your node signs a fresh nonce per submission and peers check that signature against current edge weight. Stale edges drop. A parked identity sitting at last month's zenith earns zero today, the pigment of bought reputation washes out on its own, and keeping a thousand fake edges alive needs real work every epoch. That renewal voyage is the bill, and it never stops.
